data.description:
## Context
Absence grace, retirement/tombstone behavior, explicit unretire, and append-only comment identity remain embedded in the facade after core identity extraction. Their fail-open/fail-closed boundaries are hard-won compatibility behavior.

## Outcome
Move these state transitions into `BindingLifecycle` without changing thresholds, stored shape, corruption disposition, or facade signatures.

## Plan
1. Add table tests for confirmed 404 grace, successful-read reset, three-404 retirement, tombstone suppression, explicit unretire, corrupt retired/live data, alert-write failure, and changed/unchanged comment IDs.
2. Extract the existing absence, retirement, suppression, unretire, and comment-map call clusters.
3. Keep three confirmed 404s as the retirement threshold; preserve retired corruption and alert-write fail-open behavior and live corruption fail-closed behavior.
4. Keep comment IDs append-only/change-gated and read old records without eager rewrite.

## Testing
Reload through the repository after transitions and assert bytes, alerts, tombstones, counters, and facade results.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Three confirmed 404s retire an issue, while a successful read resets absence state.
- [ ] Tombstones suppress recreation with an alert until explicit unretire.
- [ ] Retired corruption and alert-write failures remain fail-open, while live corruption remains fail-closed.
- [ ] Comment IDs append only when changed and old records without the field remain readable without rewrite.
- [ ] No lifecycle threshold, stored field, or public method signature changes.

## Out of scope
Interrupted-retirement recovery and production rich-emission cutover.
